Build's clean now — exits 0 with 0 errors. Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing the options shape it hands to modules:

- `src/core/options.js:7` — `resolveRetries` was still reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That threw on `undefined.toFixed(0)` and aborted the link stage entirely.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — `isBackoffEnabled` strictly required a boolean and threw on anything else, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed it to just treat anything not `true` as disabled.

The remaining "8 warnings" in the final line are the deprecation/lint noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, unused export, circular import, etc.) — cosmetic, not build-breaking, so I left those alone unless you want them cleaned up too.
